name: Detective Rosie Morgan: Murder on the River Thames
source: “Detective Rosie Morgan: Murder on the River Thames” is a Detective Mystery Visual Novel and Yuri Dating Sim set in London. You play as DI (Detective Inspector) Rosie Morgan, one of the best and brightest detectives in London's Metropolitan Police. See if you can help Rosie manage solving a case that has all of Britain holding its breath, while still maintaining a healthy love life in this gripping tale of passion, murder, and romance.
translation: 《罗西·摩根侦探：泰晤士河谋杀案》是一部以伦敦为背景的侦探悬疑视觉小说和尤里约会模拟游戏。你扮演DI（侦探督察）Rosie Morgan，她是伦敦大都会警察局最优秀、最聪明的侦探之一。看看你是否能帮助罗西解决一宗让整个英国屏息以待的案件，同时在这个充满激情、谋杀和浪漫的扣人心弦的故事中保持健康的爱情生活。
